chain.label: FAA did not mandate nonconductive oxygen hoses
chain.trigger: the FAA did not mandate compliance with the SBs

chain.label: Conductive oxygen hoses installed without positive separation from wiring
chain.trigger: the lack of positive separation between electrical wiring and electrically conductive oxygen system components

caused_by.evidence: Contributing to this accident was the FAA's failure to require the installation of nonconductive oxygen hoses after the safety issue concerning conductive hoses was initially identified by Boeing

chain.label: Short circuit energized oxygen hose's internal coil spring
chain.trigger: a combustible and electrically conductive oxygen hose in the supernumerary compartment became energized by a short circuit

caused_by.evidence: The lack of positive separation allowed a short circuit to breach a combustible oxygen hose

chain.label: Hose ignited, released oxygen, and fire spread through supernumerary compartment into cockpit and cargo bay
chain.trigger: which caused the hose to ignite and burn through, and that the release of oxygen from the hose caused adjacent materials to ignite and burn at an accelerated rate

caused_by.evidence: became energized by a short circuit, which caused the hose to ignite and burn through

chain.label: Airplane sustained extensive fire damage resulting in hull loss
chain.trigger: the substantial damage to the airplane resulted in a hull loss

caused_by.evidence: ABX Air reported that the substantial damage to the airplane resulted in a hull loss

chain.label: Crew evacuated through cockpit windows uninjured
chain.trigger: the captain and the first officer evacuated the airplane through the cockpit windows and were not injured

caused_by.evidence: Because of the location and the intensity of the fire, the flight crew had to evacuate the airplane through the two cockpit window exits
